messages.body:
Dear colleagues,

A short round-up from Linden Abbott before the winter. Our criminal team has finished its move to the second floor of the Corn Exchange building on Market Row, and the old side door on Tanner Street is closed to visitors. Two trainees joined us in October and will shadow our advocates at Pellbridge and Ashcombe until the new year. The secure address for case papers is unchanged. The office closes at noon on Thursday 24 December and opens again on Monday 4 January.

Diary notice for Pellbridge: M. Linden is on leave on Thursday 19 November 2026 and is not available at Pellbridge at all that day. Please take this as our notice of unavailability for that day, for every Pellbridge case M. Linden holds.

With best wishes for the season,
Linden Abbott Solicitors, criminal clerk
